why: The conjecture was proved for all sufficiently large k by Kang, Kelly, Kühn, Methuku, and Osthus, posted as arXiv:2101.04698 in Jan 2021 and published in Annals of Mathematics in 2023 -- both pre-snapshot (pre-2024-01-26). The only post-snapshot item found is a March 2025 Mathematics Magazine expository/historical article on the conjecture, which does not report new progress.

found.title: A proof of the Erdős-Faber-Lovász conjecture
